messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-gpu-pool-usw1" reason="cudaAllocFailure/gpu-alloc-fail" alert_id=PD12345
PagerDuty: Page routed to on-call: Maya (primary)
Maya: ack — I'm on it, looking at alerts and metrics
Maya: Ravi, can you pull recent dmesg and driver logs for node gpu-node-72?
Ravi: grabbing logs now, seeing repeated 'cudaErrorMemoryAllocation' in runtime logs for pod inference-runtime-12 (worker-12)
Jax: autoshedder kicked in and we got a cascade of kvcache evictions, retries piling up -> allocation churn
Maya: any customer reports yet?
Customer Success: two customers reported elevated 5xxs and timeouts for embeddings in us-west, correlating with 07:46 UTC window
Leo: quick mitigation suggestion: drain inference-gpu-pool-usw1 for new traffic and split to usw2. I'll start routing changes now
Maya: do it. Also, can we scale the pool while we investigate? +2 nodes would help absorb traffic
Jax: scaling command:

kubectl patch pool inference-gpu-pool-usw1 -p '{"spec":{"desired":6}}'

Jax: applied patch to desired=6 (was 4)
Ravi: toggling PREFETCH_KV env to false on the deployment to reduce kvcache pressure:

kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime PREFETCH_KV=false -n gpu-usw1

Ravi: PREFETCH_KV=false set, rolling update starting
Maya: watching alloc failures metric — any immediate effect?
Ravi: alloc error rate dropped ~70% on worker-12, but worker-15 showing fragmentation warnings. Starting memory compaction tasks on those nodes
PagerDuty: PD12345 acknowledged by Maya
IncidentBot: Escalation timer set: 15m to next on-call (Jax)
Maya: I'll stay until handoff in ~30m unless things regress
Jax: prepping a fallback route to force CPU for heavy-kv workloads; router patch:

curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/v1/routes/override -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"pool":"inference-gpu-pool-usw1","fallback":"cpu","reason":"gpu-alloc-fail-PD12345"}'

Jax: fallback rule applied, some requests now routed to CPU fallback — latency up but success rate improves
Customer Success: updating status page: "Partial impact to embeddings in US-WEST; mitigation in progress, ETA 30m"
Leo: driver logs show recurring cublas/cuda alloc failures with pattern 'cudaErrorMemoryAllocation at 0x7fff...' — might be fragmentation or runtime regression in 2.1.3 driver stack
Ravi: performing a soft restart of nvidia-kv-store on gpu nodes to clear driver caches:

ssh gpu-node-72 sudo systemctl restart nvidia-kv-store

Ravi: restart completed on three affected nodes
Maya: rolling restart of inference runtime deployment to pick up kernel/workaround flags:

kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n gpu-usw1

Jax: restarts rolling through nodes, monitoring
Ravi: after restarts, eviction and alloc metrics returning to baseline, new allocation failures nearly zero
Maya: good. Keep PD open until we confirm stable for 20m and customers notified
IncidentBot: PD12345 escalated to Jax (on-call next)
Jax: ack — taking over. I'll compile timeline and start a remediation ticket for runbook updates and lower kvprefetch alarm thresholds
Maya: handoff: summary -> drained pool, scaled +2 nodes, disabled prefetch, enforced CPU fallback for heavy-kv requests, restarted runtimes and nvidia kv-store on 3 nodes. Customer impact: limited to ~2% global QPS, two customers contacted, no data loss.
Customer Success: Thanks everyone — we'll send a follow-up to affected customers with details and ETA for RCA
Jax: will own postmortem and runbook change, escalations to eng-runtime if driver regression confirmed
Customer Success: :thumbsup:
Maya: closing my shift here, leaving PD open for 20m of stability then will close if clean
Jax: will update PD and create ticket PD12345-RCA when I have notes
